source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    vertical = False
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and w - 1 - c == c:
            split, vertical = c, True
            break
    if split is None:
        for r in range(1, h - 1):
            if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and h - 1 - r == r:
                split = r
                break
    if vertical:
        a = [row[:split] for row in grid]
        b = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        a, b = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    mismatch = min(common)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else mismatch for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
